{"id":1906481741,"question_id":3952,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"5 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1770109022,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1906481741/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Trionic Array I","memory":"27.7 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    bool isTrionic(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n\n        int i = 0;\n        int end = n-1;\n        \n        while(i+1 < n and nums[i] < nums[i+1]) i++;\n\n        if(i == 0 or i == end) return false;\n        //got point P here\n        int pointP = i;\n\n        while(i+1 < n and nums[i] > nums[i+1]) i++;\n\n        if(i == pointP or i == end) return false;\n        //got point Q here\n        int pointQ = i;\n\n        while(i+1 < n and nums[i] < nums[i+1]) i++;\n\n        return i != pointQ and i == end;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"trionic-array-i","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1635}
